description: Turns a period's financials into the finance section of a board deck. It takes a P&L export, plus optional prior-period and plan figures, and drafts structured text: headline metrics, period-over-period movement, the narrative behind each move, and an always-present list of what it could not figure out from the input. Hand it a past board deck and it matches that deck's format, swapping in this period's numbers and commentary. It never invents a figure and never guesses at a cause it cannot trace back to the input. Text only, no slides, charts, or images.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
